{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# exp-007 LAMBADA per-example logprob batch collection
set -euo pipefail

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

OUTPUT_BASE="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/lm_eval_clean/exp007"
MODELS_340M="/root/autodl-tmp/models"
MODELS_1_3B="/root/autodl-tmp/models_1.3b"
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

COMPLETED=0
SKIPPED=0
FAILED=0

run_model() {
    local model_path="$1"
    local output_dir="$2"

    if find "$output_dir" -name "samples_lambada_openai*.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
        echo "[SKIP] $output_dir already has samples"
        SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED + 1))
        return 0
    fi

    mkdir -p "$output_dir"

    local start_time=$(date +%s)
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[START] $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo "  Model: $model_path"
    echo "  Output: $output_dir"
    echo "=========================================="

    local rc=0
    python3 "$SCRIPT_DIR/run_lm_eval_fla.py" \
        --model_path "$model_path" \
        --output_path "$output_dir" || rc=$?

    local end_time=$(date +%s)
    local elapsed=$((end_time - start_time))

    if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "[DONE] Completed in ${elapsed}s -> $output_dir"
        COMPLETED=$((COMPLETED + 1))
    else
        echo "[FAIL] Failed after ${elapsed}s (exit code $rc)"
        FAILED=$((FAILED + 1))
    fi

    return 0
}

echo "============================================"
echo "exp-007 LAMBADA log_samples batch run"
echo "Started: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "============================================"

# --- 340M models (16 total) ---
echo ""
echo "=== 340M Models ==="

run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-GatedDeltaNet-pure-baseline"     "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/GDN-pure"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-GatedDeltaNet-hybrid-3-1"        "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/GDN-h3-1"

run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-RetNet-pure"           "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/RetNet-pure"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-3-1"     "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/RetNet-h3-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-6-1"     "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/RetNet-h6-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-12-1"    "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/RetNet-h12-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-RetNet-hybrid-24-1"    "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/RetNet-h24-1"

run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-HGRN2-pure-baseline"   "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/HGRN2-pure"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-3-1"      "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/HGRN2-h3-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-6-1"      "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/HGRN2-h6-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-12-1"     "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/HGRN2-h12-1"
run_model "$MODELS_340M/340M-20B-HGRN2-hybrid-24-1"     "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/HGRN2-h24-1"

run_model "$MODELS_340M/transformer_340M_baseline"       "$OUTPUT_BASE/340m/Transformer"

# --- 1.3B models (11 missing) ---
echo ""
echo "=== 1.3B Models ==="

run_model "$MODELS_1_3B/1.3B-100B-GatedDeltaNet-pure"           "$OUTPUT_BASE/1.3b/GDN-pure"

run_model "$MODELS_1_3B/1.3B-100B-RetNet-hybrid-3-1"    "$OUTPUT_BASE/1.3b/RetNet-h3-1"
run_model "$MODELS_1_3B/1.3B-100B-RetNet-hybrid-6-1"    "$OUTPUT_BASE/1.3b/RetNet-h6-1"
run_model "$MODELS_1_3B/1.3B-100B-RetNet-hybrid-12-1"   "$OUTPUT_BASE/1.3b/RetNet-h12-1"

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""lm-eval wrapper with fla auto-class registration and HGRN2 monkey-patch."""
import argparse
import sys

import fla  # registers all fla model types in transformers auto classes

from fla.models.hgrn2 import HGRN2ForCausalLM
HGRN2ForCausalLM._tied_weights_keys = {}

from lm_eval.__main__ import cli_evaluate

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--model_path", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output_path", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    sys.argv = [
        "lm_eval",
        "--model", "hf",
        "--model_args", f"pretrained={args.model_path},trust_remote_code=True,dtype=bfloat16",
        "--tasks", "lambada_openai",
        "--log_samples",
        "--batch_size", "auto",
        "--output_path", args.output_path,
    ]
